_about: Settings for the automatic request list (requests_scan.py, run every 2 hours by .github/workflows/requests.yml). account: the TikTok account whose video comments are read. phrases: a comment counts as a request when it contains one of these (lowercase, accents ignored; matched as whole words). options: the drawings traced for each request (no-crop ones: a profile picture is already framed). video: the one rendered ready to post. max_per_run: requests processed per run (about 2 min each).

video.caption: one line drawing of a random comment's pfp
